title: Chapter 209
text:
The dust dissipated, revealing its true appearance.

A heavy mechanical arm that was several times thicker than a human arm was grabbing Luhn's fist tightly. The high-density platinum alloy was dark and cold, full of the luster of steel.

Han Xiao, who was controlling this huge mechanical arm, had already put on the Viper Modified. The sleek black mechanical suit was like a human body with bulging muscles.

Everyone was stunned.

"What is this thing?"

Han Xiao's right hand that was not wearing the mechanical arm grabbed Luhn's arm. Luhn wanted to break free, but he found that Han Xiao's strength was now on par with his, and he could not break free for a while.

The Viper Modified provided almost 80 Strength and 50 Dexterity. Han Xiao's Strength, Dexterity, and Endurance were now not inferior to any Pugilist below LV 60!

Luhn was still measuring the difference between them like before, and he was caught off guard.

The heavy mechanical arm on Han Xiao's left hand roared, and he smashed Luhn's head into the ground. He continued to smash Luhn's head into the ground, and the crater on the ground quickly grew larger.

[Iron Fist – Mounted Heavy Mechanical Arm (Left)]

Quality: Blue (Good)

Basic Attributes: Attack 85-88, Defense 26-30, Power Rank 77, Durability 986/1050

Requirements: 45 STR, 45-90 STR, -45% Attack Speed, -15% STR over 90 STR (Does not count the equipment's attribute bonus)

Additional Effect: + 28 STR

Length: 1.24 meters (Includes external armor)

Weight: 85.5 pounds

Additional Ability: Bionic (Human) – Can make movements like a human's arm through torque and transmission straps. Will not restrict the operator's arm movements, very flexible.

Additional Ability: Impact Resistance – External armor is made of platinum alloy, extra durability, not easy to wear out.

Special Feature: Removable

Remark: Big fist will smash your head!

Since he was acting alone, Han Xiao had all his trump cards in his equipment bag. He disassembled the heavy mechanical arm into its components, making it easy to carry around. Furthermore, the assembly was very simple and fast, so it could be quickly formed in the face of a battle.

When Vanessa saw Luhn being pressed to the ground, she was both shocked and furious. She quickly rushed forward. Han Xiao did not dodge and fought with Vanessa in close combat. His punches and kicks contained immense strength, causing the ground to crack inch by inch.

Shockwave Blast was a mid-range attack. It did not have enough lethality and would not hurt the mech at all. Viper's modified power mode had the upper hand.

The two of them were extremely agile, and their fight was like a flash of lightning. In the eyes of the bystanders, it was just two blurry figures entangling with each other. Only the continuous loud noises and the destruction of the environment by the aftermath of the battle could tell how dangerous the two of them were.

The black fist hit Vanessa's face several times, and her nose started to bleed.

At the same time, Luhn finally pulled himself out of the ground. His head was bleeding, and he pounced forward with a roar. However, halfway through, Han Xiao suddenly swung his fist and swept Vanessa to the side. He then took out the folded Ghost sniper rifle on his back and aimed it at Luhn.

The black muzzle gave off an even more dangerous aura than before.

Luhn's hair stood on end!

Han Xiao pulled the trigger.

[Flaming Will]!

[Fatal Critical Hit]!

[Overload]!

This spear strike was the most lethal attack he had ever unleashed up to this point!

It was not just the effect of his active skills. His passive skills made his shooting power, critical hit rate, and Machinery Affinity even stronger. Furthermore, his gun had undergone the best enhancement. Everything was one level higher than before!

This was the power of maxed out skills!

Bang!

A huge cavity appeared in Luhn's chest, and blood gushed out like a fountain.

You have dealt 1942 damage to Luhn (LV 58). (Damage reduction has been calculated)

It was extremely close to 2,000 damage!

One had to know that Luhn's HP was only around 4,000 to 5,000!

One shot, and almost half of his HP was gone!

Luhn knelt on the ground, his whole body twitching. He raised his head and looked at Han Xiao, his eyes full of shock and disbelief.

Under the cold mask, an emotionless mechanical voice sounded. "Didn't you say that you were going to paint the floor with my brain?"

Han Xiao pressed Luhn to the ground with his right hand and smashed his left mechanical arm into Luhn's head. Luhn was paralyzed by this shot and had no energy to protect his body. The steel kissed his skull again and again. His skin and flesh were torn apart, and his bones were crushed.

Blood splattered everywhere and dyed the ground and mechanical arm red.

You have killed Luhn (LV 58). You have received 175000 EXP!

[Lethal Shot] talent, unlock progress 43/50

"Luhn!" Vanessa screamed. Her voice was filled with sadness, hatred, and anger. Then … she turned and ran.

Black Phantom was unexpectedly strong. She did not want to die. Only by surviving could she have a chance to take revenge.

"That's why I said that it's not good to live." Han Xiao shook his head and unbuckled the heavy mechanical arm. The huge metal arm fell to the ground. Han Xiao gave a command, and the armor on the left and right sides suddenly slid open, revealing a row of densely packed small holes. Dozens of thin arrow-shaped black shadows shot out and landed around Vanessa. They exploded one after another and made a high-frequency sound wave.

These were all miniaturized versions of the Explosive Grenades. Han Xiao made them into smaller arrowheads. He then added a simple firing module to Viper, which allowed him to release this portable and practical control weapon.

The Boom Grenades' attribute was Endurance. Although Vanessa was a Pugilist, dozens of Boom Grenades were too much for her to handle. She fell to the ground in pain.

With a few leaps, Han Xiao activated the Thermal Incisor Gauntlets and clawed at Vanessa's eye sockets. He then activated the 'Sunworm' flamethrower on his wrist. Vanessa was quickly turned into a piece of charcoal in the midst of screams and the burnt smell. Vanessa's struggle before she died was all blocked by Viper's modified armor.

Han Xiao let go of his hand and let the body fall to the ground. He activated the various scanning modules of the mechanical suit. Through smell analysis, the image of the Hidden Demon was outlined on the scanning panel. He was now lying in the area where the Boom Grenades exploded, twitching in pain.

The Hidden Demon was already scared out of his wits by Han Xiao. It had only been a few months since the last time they fought, and the Hidden Demon had already reached a level that shocked him. He regretted accepting this mission and quickly wanted to retreat. However, he was very unlucky. When he was secretly escaping, he was knocked over by the aftermath of the explosion.

"Saved me a lot of trouble." Han Xiao broke the Hidden Demon's arms and legs. He then took out a mini GPS device and violently stabbed it into the Hidden Demon's body. He then slapped him unconscious and nodded with satisfaction. "This way, I won't get lost."

The scene was a mess. A large number of Overmera spectators had gathered. They were all shocked by Han Xiao's cruel methods.

The players who had been revived stood in the distance. Their throats were dry.

"This … is so strong!" Zhu Yu Xuan exclaimed. She had just recorded all the battle videos. She had a feeling that this material would definitely be popular.

Black Phantom had never shown his mechanical suit before. The strong performances that they had seen so far were actually just the tip of the iceberg. This was his true strength!

No, maybe Black Phantom was hiding more things.

The members of the Bamboo Rain Guild were excited. They felt that they had found information that no one else knew. Among all the players, only they had encountered this unexpected storyline. Zhu Yu Xuan recorded the whole process and was very excited.

Lagos's face was full of fear. His teeth were chattering, and his legs were shaking uncontrollably. The three strong people that he had high hopes for had been killed so easily. According to Black Phantom's original strength, Luhn and the other two would have been a piece of cake. Who would have known that he had such a terrifying trump card?

"How is this possible? Luhn and the other two are all top supers. They are legends who have been famous for a long time. I've asked the professionals. How could Black Phantom kill them so easily?" Lagos could not believe it.

Without anyone to rely on, facing the murderous Black Phantom, Lagos's body went soft. Regret could not describe his feelings.

Han Xiao walked to Lagos' side, patted Lagos' shoulder, and said softly, "I've already spared you once."

"You can't kill me!" Lagos tried to act tough. "I'm the manager of the Home Sect. If you kill me, the Home Sect …"

Before he could finish.

The sharp blade slid across his neck. Blood splattered softly.

There was no hesitation.

Lagos' eyes widened. He held his neck and fell down. His temperature dropped along with the blood. His leaking windpipe made a sizzling sound. He looked up at Han Xiao in disbelief.
